Stats

Companion_Boar
Verres is a boar summoned via a Beast Master's  Boar Companion ability, a variant of  Ranger's Companion. Verres "upgrades" to  Verres Major once the Beast Master reaches level 5, and becomes  Verres Calamitosus once the Beast Master reaches level 11.

Combat

Attacks and actions

Due to the  Prey's Scent passive, Beast Master rangers may wish to attack the target marked by  Hunter's Mark for optimal damage.

 Boar Charge ()
Damage: 2~5
1d4 + 1⁠Slashing

Charge forward, attacking all enemies in the way and possibly knocking them  Prone.

Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.
